key_insight: Schema-driven extraction, temporal constraints, and source provenance enable auditable financial knowledge graphs whose quality can be evaluated independently of downstream retrieval.
engineering_relevance: The methodology offers a blueprint for preserving issuer identity, reporting periods, and evidence traceability when turning heterogeneous financial documents into structured knowledge.
method: Parse page-delimited documents and extract entities, quantitative observations, and relationships from overlapping windows using phased LLM processing.
Validate candidates against schemas and resolve entities with scope-aware exact, normalized, fuzzy, embedding-based, and LLM-assisted matching.
Apply temporal merge constraints, deterministic edge deduplication, conflict-aware property management, and fine-grained provenance.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports an evidence-grounded temporal graph and an intrinsic evaluation framework with seven weighted dimensions, two hard validation gates, and structural diagnostics, but no numerical results.
watch_item: Intrinsic graph-quality evaluation does not by itself establish improvements in downstream retrieval or answer accuracy.
paper_title: Auditable Financial Knowledge Graphs: Schema-Driven Construction and Intrinsic Quality Evaluation
